grh_d688fdebdd08f937d7a2.title: The Great Lover
paragraphs: Freddie Hunter, an insecure scoutmaster sailing for Europe with his boys, tries to remake himself into a sophisticated ladies' man after meeting a beautiful Duchess and her gambling father. His attempts at high-stakes poker and romance put him in the path of a mysterious card-table murderer, and Freddie soon becomes the chief suspect and has to hide while the ship searches for him. The real killer is Dabney, who plans to murder Freddie and the Duchess and make their deaths look like another disappearance. Freddie and his unlikely canine ally expose and subdue Dabney, clearing Freddie's name and leaving him free to pursue the Duchess as the ship reaches shore.

This [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] broadcast aired on March 22, 1951. It is listed as episode 95 in the archive. [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Bob Hope, Rhonda Fleming, Jim Backus, Walter Tetley, and Fritz Feld. Other credited names include Bill Cairn as director, Howard Wiley as producer, Richard Allen Simmons as radio adaptor, and Jimmy Wallington as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 60 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.0ee8343bca2245d4|Chesterfield]] and [[org|org.47c43e9eb0213c63|RCA]].
This version presents a radio version of [[work|work.sdp.film.57961d5b8148269c|The Great Lover]]. Richard Allen Simmons adapted it for radio.

grh_d664869bf9a256bef998.title: Murder on the Riviera
paragraphs: While smuggling American cigarettes along the Riviera, Harry encounters Danielle beside a car containing her dead husband and helps her dispose of the vehicle before taking her along. Danielle claims the dead man owed her fifteen million francs, but her shifting story leaves Harry unsure whether she murdered him for the money. As they prepare to flee by train, police arrive after tracing Harry's cigarette truck. Danielle panics, grabs a gun and shoots Harry in the shoulder before officers disarm her. Police say her final account is that she tried to hold her husband at gunpoint for money and killed him when he grabbed for the weapon. Harry survives but is arrested for cigarette smuggling and sent from the hospital toward jail.

grh_d6bbdea37292c6e16941.title: A Kiss in the Dark
paragraphs: Concert pianist Eric Phillips unexpectedly becomes owner of the Cleopatra Arms apartment house and initially sees its tenants and problems as annoyances distracting him from his career. Model Polly Haynes and devoted manager Willoughby gradually force him to see the people behind the property, especially after he learns Willoughby ruined himself financially trying to care for the building and its residents. Eric begins using his money and influence to solve their problems instead of escaping them, restores Willoughby as manager for life, and discovers that his growing concern for the tenants is inseparable from his love for Polly.

grh_d6a7b788fd92253ec610.title: Mr Freak
paragraphs: Paul has hidden from society because a badly deformed face has taught him to expect ridicule and rejection. He befriends a blind young woman who knows him only through his voice and kindness, and their closeness deepens as she prepares for an operation that may restore her sight. Convinced that seeing him will destroy her affection, Paul nearly kills himself, but she finds him first, looks directly at the face he hates and tells him that she loves him in the light as she did in darkness.
